saw_lines: Dive watch buyers keep one piece for decades, so they check history and proof before they spend.
So the sale is won on the homepage and first ad line, where history and proof either show up or get skipped.
Your site cites more than 130 years, yet 0 of 30 ads carry that number. Print 130 years on the creative of three new ads and open two with a customer quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your site cites more than 130 years, yet 0 of 30 ads carry that number, so buyers miss the reason to trust the watch. Print 130 years on the creative of three new ads and open two with a customer quote.

Your site offers a guarantee and free shipping, yet 0 of 20 copy ads mention either, so a first time buyer has no push to act today. Put the guarantee in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.
8 of your 20 copy ads open on one summer line, so most of the account repeats one story. Write two or three openers from the product, like the 1969 dive heritage, and test them against it.
None of your 30 live ads is video, so the watch never moves on screen in a feed. Shoot three short videos of the SUB 200 on a wrist by the water and run them beside your oldest ads.

ads_1: Dive heritage and SUB 200 openers tested against the summer line
